398:     # Repeat for estimate
399:     agree_est = np.equal.outer(y_est, y_est)
400:     n_agree_est = (agree_est.sum() - len(y_est)) / 2.0
401: 
402:     # Find where they agree
403:     matches = np.logical_and(agree_ref, agree_est)
404:     n_matches = (matches.sum() - len(y_ref)) / 2.0
405: 
406:     precision = n_matches / n_agree_est
407:     recall = n_matches / n_agree_ref
408:     f_measure = util.f_measure(precision, recall, beta=beta)
409: 
410:     return precision, recall, f_measure
411: 
412: 
413: def rand_index(
414:     reference_intervals,
415:     reference_labels,
416:     estimated_intervals,
417:     estimated_labels,
418:     frame_size=0.1,
419:     beta=1.0,
420: ):
421:     """(Non-adjusted) Rand index.
422: 
423:     Examples
424:     --------
425:     >>> (ref_intervals,
426:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('ref.lab')
427:     >>> (est_intervals,
428:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('est.lab')
429:     >>> # Trim or pad the estimate to match reference timing
430:     >>> (ref_intervals,
431:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(ref_intervals,
432:     ...                                               ref_labels,
433:     ...                                               t_min=0)
434:     >>> (est_intervals,
435:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
436:     ...     est_intervals, est_labels, t_min=0, t_max=ref_intervals.max())
437:     >>> rand_index = mir_eval.structure.rand_index(ref_intervals,
438:     ...                                            ref_labels,
439:     ...                                            est_intervals,
440:     ...                                            est_labels)
441: 
442:     Parameters
443:     ----------
444:     reference_intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(n, 2)
445:         reference segment intervals, in the format returned by
446:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
447:     reference_labels : list, shape=(n,)
448:         reference segment labels, in the format returned by
449:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
450:     estimated_intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(m, 2)
451:         estimated segment intervals, in the format returned by
452:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
453:     estimated_labels : list, shape=(m,)
454:         estimated segment labels, in the format returned by
455:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
456:     frame_size : float > 0
457:         length (in seconds) of frames for clustering
458:         (Default value = 0.1)
459:     beta : float > 0
460:         beta value for F-measure
461:         (Default value = 1.0)
462: 
463:     Returns
464:     -------
465:     rand_index : float > 0
466:         Rand index
467:     """
468:     validate_structure(
469:         reference_intervals, reference_labels, estimated_intervals, estimated_labels
470:     )
471: 
472:     # Check for empty annotations.  Don't need to check labels because
473:     # validate_structure makes sure they're the same size as intervals
474:     if reference_intervals.size == 0 or estimated_intervals.size == 0:
475:         return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
476: 
477:     # Generate the cluster labels
478:     y_ref = util.intervals_to_samples(
479:         reference_intervals, reference_labels, sample_size=frame_size
480:     )[-1]
481: 
482:     y_ref = util.index_labels(y_ref)[0]
483: 
484:     # Map to index space
485:     y_est = util.intervals_to_samples(
486:         estimated_intervals, estimated_labels, sample_size=frame_size
487:     )[-1]
488: 
489:     y_est = util.index_labels(y_est)[0]
490: 
491:     # Build the reference label agreement matrix
492:     agree_ref = np.equal.outer(y_ref, y_ref)
493: 
494:     # Repeat for estimate
495:     agree_est = np.equal.outer(y_est, y_est)
496: 
497:     # Find where they agree
498:     matches_pos = np.logical_and(agree_ref, agree_est)
499: 
500:     # Find where they disagree
501:     matches_neg = np.logical_and(~agree_ref, ~agree_est)
502: 
503:     n_pairs = len(y_ref) * (len(y_ref) - 1) / 2.0
504: 
505:     n_matches_pos = (matches_pos.sum() - len(y_ref)) / 2.0
506:     n_matches_neg = matches_neg.sum() / 2.0
507:     rand = (n_matches_pos + n_matches_neg) / n_pairs
508: 
509:     return rand
510: 
511: 
512: def _contingency_matrix(reference_indices, estimated_indices):
513:     """Compute the contingency matrix of a true labeling vs an estimated one.
514: 
515:     Parameters
516:     ----------
517:     reference_indices : np.ndarray
518:         Array of reference indices
519:     estimated_indices : np.ndarray
520:         Array of estimated indices
521: 
522:     Returns
523:     -------
524:     contingency_matrix : np.ndarray
525:         Contingency matrix, shape=(#reference indices, #estimated indices)
526:     .. note:: Based on sklearn.metrics.cluster.contingency_matrix
527: 
528:     """
529:     ref_classes, ref_class_idx = np.unique(reference_indices, return_inverse=True)
530:     est_classes, est_class_idx = np.unique(estimated_indices, return_inverse=True)
531:     n_ref_classes = ref_classes.shape[0]
532:     n_est_classes = est_classes.shape[0]
533:     # Using coo_matrix is faster than histogram2d
534:     return scipy.sparse.coo_matrix(
535:         (np.ones(ref_class_idx.shape[0]), (ref_class_idx, est_class_idx)),
536:         shape=(n_ref_classes, n_est_classes),
537:         dtype=np.int64,
538:     ).toarray()
539: 
540: 
541: def _adjusted_rand_index(reference_indices, estimated_indices):
542:     """Compute the Rand index, adjusted for change.
543: 
544:     Parameters
545:     ----------
546:     reference_indices : np.ndarray
547:         Array of reference indices
548:     estimated_indices : np.ndarray
549:         Array of estimated indices
550: 
551:     Returns
552:     -------
553:     ari : float
